description: Export prospects to a UTF-8 (BOM) CSV that opens cleanly in Excel or Sheets. Select by list or by prospect_ids. RFC 4180 quoting plus a formula-injection guard. Suppressed prospects are excluded unless include_suppressed=true. Free and local. Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless overwrite=true. Does not upload anything.
name: sdr_export_csv
title: Export CSV
